source.decision_context: The product owner supplied the exact corrected durable-storage definition digest in direct response to the requirement for explicit acceptance after the generic-storage and Solana-instantiation responsibilities were separated.

accepted_responsibility_boundary.durable_storage: owns the generic storage definitions and required semantic instantiation slots
accepted_responsibility_boundary.consumer_capability: reuses or specializes generic definitions and supplies consumer-owned semantic values through an explicit Durable Storage Capability Instantiation
accepted_responsibility_boundary.solana_coownership: is the intended first consumer but its accepted predecessor definition set does not yet instantiate durable storage
accepted_responsibility_boundary.implementation_binding: later supplies provider, adapter, environment, configuration, and credential references without redefining consumer semantics

acceptance.effect: Makes the exact generic durable-storage definitions an accepted predecessor for a separately authorized Durable Storage Product Capability candidate.

authority_effect: accepts only KEP-DST-DEFINITION-SET-001 at the exact supplied digest
excluded_effects: Durable Storage Product Capability authorship or adoption
Solana definition-set mutation, successor acceptance, or capability instantiation
business-ontology or DomainSpec authorship or admission
provider, adapter, endpoint, policy-value, credential, or deployment selection
network access, publication, release, deployment, payment, or other external effect
